d: Cameron Bancroft breaks silence on Sandpapergate scandal claiming entire Australian cricket team knew about sandpaper ball-tampering in 2018 Cape Town Test and he was made scapegoat after being caught on camera. In a detailed column for The West Australian, the former opener reveals teammates including Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Marsh and Tim Paine gave feedback on the ball, while coach Darren Lehmann and others were aware, prompting fresh controversy over the infamous cricket cheating incident involving Steve Smith and David Warner.
